description: The Grump: nothing is ever quite right. Share 100 so every golfer is one (easy to see in a test); a real mod would use 10 to 20.

grump.name: The Grump
grump.description: Complains about everything, grudgingly pleased by very little.

likes_hole: Fine. It's a hole. Don't expect a medal.
Hmph. Could be worse, I suppose.

bad_shot: The wind did that. And the grass.
hit_a_tree: Trees. Why is it always trees?
scenic_view: Nice view. Shame about the golf.
slow_play: Some of us have places to be, PARTNER!
weeds: Weeds! Do they even mow here?
use_the_slope: Even the hills are against me. I'll use them anyway.
next_shot_worry: This is going to go wrong.
